companies.name: トリニダード・トバゴ国営ガス会社

relations.text: トリニダード産の天然ガスは、同社とその子会社に全量が販売された
relations.text_en: All natural gas from EOG's Trinidad operations was sold to this company and its subsidiary

source.label: EOG Resources 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025 and 2024, all natural gas from EOG's Trinidad operations was sold to the National Gas Company of Trinidad and Tobago Limited and its subsidiary.

companies.name_en: National Gas Company of Trinidad and Tobago

companies.name: ヘリテージ・ペトロリアム

relations.text: トリニダード産の原油とコンデンセートの販売先になっている
relations.text_en: Trinidad crude oil and condensate is sold to this company and/or BP Trinidad and Tobago LLC

source.label: EOG Resources 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025 and 2024, all crude oil and condensate from EOG's Trinidad operations was sold to Heritage Petroleum Company Limited and/or BP Trinidad and Tobago LLC.

companies.name: BPトリニダード・トバゴ

relations.text: 原油とコンデンセートは、ヘリテージ社とBPトリニダード・トバゴの両社に販売される
relations.text_en: Crude oil and condensate are sold to both Heritage Petroleum and BP Trinidad and Tobago LLC

source.label: EOG Resources 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Crude oil and condensate are sold to both Heritage Petroleum Company Limited and BP Trinidad and Tobago LLC.

relations.text: 2025年2月、子会社がバーレーンのガス探鉱案件で探鉱参加契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In February 2025, an EOG subsidiary signed an exploration participation agreement with Bapco in Bahrain

source.label: EOG Resources 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In February 2025, a subsidiary of EOG signed an exploration participation agreement with Bapco Energies B.S.C. (Closed) (Bapco) to evaluate a gas exploration prospect in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
